title: Steroids and response
text: In this made-up cohort, steroids were given for neurotoxicity. Patients who received steroids early had similar response rates. Short courses of steroids did not reduce expansion. Steroids are common after CAR-T.

title: Infections after CAR-T
text: Infections were common in the first month. Bacterial infections came first and viral infections later. Severe infections were less common. Infections were tracked for one year.

title: Managing CRS
text: Tocilizumab is the first drug for CRS. When tocilizumab did not work, steroids were added. Tocilizumab doses followed the label. Most patients needed one dose of tocilizumab; a second dose of tocilizumab was rare.

title: Steroid timing
text: Steroids were recorded with their start day. The use of steroids was common in severe cases. Infections and steroids were both recorded in the case report form.

title: ICANS rates
text: ICANS occurred in a common share of patients and was mostly mild. Infections were also recorded. The common grading system was used.
